objects.name: task
objects.description: One piece of engineering work an agent is asked to carry out end to end.

objects.name: assignment
objects.description: One stretch of a task being held by one assignee, kept after it ends.

objects.name: task_todo
objects.description: One ordered step a task was decomposed into by a planning run.

objects.name: agent
objects.description: An AI agent that claims tasks, works them, and reports what it did.

objects.name: project
objects.description: A sprint, milestone or epic that related tasks are grouped under.

objects.name: tag
objects.description: A free-form label such as setup or auth, attached to any number of tasks.

objects.name: deliverable
objects.description: An artifact a task or one of its steps must produce before it counts as done.

objects.name: acceptance_criteria
objects.description: A condition a reviewer checks before accepting the work a task produced.

objects.name: workflow_run
objects.description: One orchestrated execution, anchoring every task and step it produced.

objects.name: import_project_job
objects.description: One asynchronous import of a project board and the tasks read out of it.

objects.name: task_block
objects.description: A hard gate holding one task until another reaches a terminal status.

objects.name: task_dependency
objects.description: A soft ordering recording that one task follows another, with no gate.

objects.name: task_project_membership
objects.description: Records that one task is part of one project.

objects.name: task_tag
objects.description: Records that one label is attached to one task.

objects.name: code_sequence
objects.description: The next number to mint for one kind of thing's stable code.

objects.name: case
objects.description: A request somebody brought, worked through the tasks linked to it.

objects.name: case_task
objects.description: Records that one task is worked for one case.

objects.name: case_vote
objects.description: One member's vote on one case, and who cast it.

objects.name: repeating_task
objects.description: A template made again every period of its schedule, each made one due by the period's end.

objects.name: repeating_task_period
objects.description: One period a repeating template has made its task for.

objects.name: sourced_task
objects.description: One item a source listed, and the task opened for it.

objects.name: generated_task
objects.description: One subject a run generated a task for, and that task.
